categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the industrial gases sector, producing and selling a variety of gases including high-purity oxygen, nitrogen, argon, medical oxygen, food-grade nitrogen, industrial oxygen, carbon dioxide, hydrogen, electronic gases, and mixed gases. The company serves traditional industries such as metallurgy, chemical, military, medical, and food, as well as emerging sectors like new energy, semiconductors, electronics, biomedicine, new materials, and photovoltaics. It operates production bases mainly in Sichuan and Fujian provinces, focusing on liquid, pipeline, and bottled gas supply modes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced air separation and physical purification technologies, including full-liquid air separation production lines, vacuum pipeline applications, anti-flicker power technology, energy recovery and comprehensive utilization, and liquid filling system safety technologies. It has developed proprietary technologies to improve gas purity and extraction efficiency while reducing energy consumption. Production methods integrate liquefaction, regasification, cylinder filling, and gas mixing to meet diverse customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large industrial enterprises in metallurgy, chemical, military, medical, food, machinery manufacturing, new energy, semiconductor, electronic information, biomedicine, and new materials sectors. Notable clients are listed companies such as Fujian Sansteel Min Guang, Tongwei Co., Ltd., Dongfang Electric, Lier Chemical, Silan Microelectronics, CATL, Huayou Cobalt, and major steel enterprises like Panzhihua Steel Group and Baosteel Desheng. The company also serves prominent military research institutes and large hospitals in Sichuan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in the Southwest China region, especially Sichuan and Chongqing (Chengdu, Dujiangyan, Wenchuan, Meishan, Jintang, Deyang), and in Fujian province (Fuzhou and surrounding areas). It has production bases and sales networks concentrated in these regions, serving the local industrial clusters and expanding pipeline gas projects in these areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas is positioned midstream in the industrial gas supply chain, focusing on the production, purification, liquefaction, and distribution of industrial gases. It procures raw materials mainly as air and energy (electricity, natural gas, gasoline, diesel), and supplies finished gas products directly to end customers and distributors. The company also engages in pipeline gas onsite production and liquid gas delivery, integrating production and logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes R&D in air separation technology, energy efficiency, and gas purity enhancement. Key R&D projects include efficient recovery of vented nitrogen, vacuum pipeline installation, anti-flicker power technology, and energy recovery systems. It plans to expand into specialty gases for electronics, semiconductors, and new materials, including high-purity liquid oxygen, liquid ammonia, hydrocarbon gases, fluorocarbons, and ultra-high purity electronic mixed gases. The company is also exploring hydrogen production via coal gasification, LNG reforming, chemical tail gas extraction, and water electrolysis.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of industrial gases in various forms: liquid gas, pipeline gas, and bottled gas. Sales are made directly to end customers under supply contracts, with billing based on delivered or consumed volumes. The company also sells to gas trading companies and filling stations. Revenue recognition follows delivery or confirmed consumption, with pipeline gas revenue confirmed via joint meter readings and settlement.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international industrial gas giants such as Linde, Air Products, Air Liquide, Praxair, and Messer, which have strong presence in China, especially in large-scale onsite pipeline gas projects. Domestically, competitors include Yingde Gas, Heyuan Gas, and Hangyang Group, as well as former state-owned gas suppliers now operating independently. Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas holds a leading position in Southwest China with the largest full-liquid air separation capacity and strong local market presence, leveraging cost and logistics advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.02 billion, a slight increase of 0.2% over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 149 million, down 26.4% year-on-year. The company has total assets near RMB 2 billion and equity of about RMB 1.75 billion. Cash flow from operations improved by 42.5%. The company is investing in capacity expansion projects, including a 40,000 Nm³/h air separation project in Jintang and a new Deyang base under construction, indicating growth ambitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sichuan Qiaoyuan Gas emphasizes its regional first-mover advantage in the Southwest China market, high product quality with strict adherence to national standards, and a comprehensive product portfolio covering traditional and emerging industries. The company boasts advanced full-liquid air separation technology, large-scale production capacity, and cost advantages due to efficient energy use and hydropower availability. Its professional logistics and distribution network ensures timely supply, while diversified supply modes (liquid, pipeline, bottled) and strong customer service enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
